english.title: Driver of taxi / private hire vehicle fail to comply with their duty in assisting disabled passenger to find vehicle
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a pre-booked taxi or private hire vehicle namely, **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..) which had been hired by

(A)_[or for]_
(B)_[a person who wished to be accompanied by]_

a disabled person, and who had been made aware before the start of the passenger's journey in the vehicle that the passenger required assistance to identify or find that vehicle, failed to comply with the duty to take such steps as were reasonable to assist the passenger to identify and find the vehicle which had been hired and not to make, or propose to make, an additional charge for complying with the duty in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165A(6) and (7) of the Equality Act 2010.
